amends: the optimisation budget and the sampling scope for one diagnostic run only; nothing about the world, the reward, the observation or the acceptance criteria
when: after the per-leg-head run, before the diagnostic run

evidence.eight_arms_same_ceiling: six teacher/architecture arms all landed between 1 and 6 legs passing, and the passing count never exceeded 3 even when the imitation error dropped to 0.00795
evidence.the_failure_is_two_specific_phases: LF and RF raise the foot to pad heights 1.46-1.47 and end the episode with the pad at +1.04/+0.42, i.e. still in the air, while LH and RH end loaded but with forward advance exactly 0.0000
evidence.training_internal_placement: the stochastic policy places a foot on 25-35% of episodes while the deterministic mean ends with the foot in the air, so the behaviour exists in the action distribution but has not become the mean
evidence.why_this_run: the trust region allows roughly 4-6 minibatch steps per update and the round has used 24 updates. Whether a placement phase simply needs more optimiser steps is cheap to test on a single leg and is the discriminating experiment before any further design change

sampling.old: leg chosen at random per episode
sampling.new: FIXED_LEG=LF, sampling restricted to the left front leg (a diagnostic scope reduction, declared in the log as fixed_leg)

change.everything_else: unchanged: same teacher (raise 60, swing 90, hold 0.5), same reward, same 495-dimensional observation, same per-leg heads, same acceptance criteria, same seed

preregistered_outcomes: if LF reaches all five criteria, the placement phase is an optimisation-budget problem and the next round scales the budget on all six legs

if LF still ends in the air at 96 updates, the deterministic policy is trapped in a lift-forever mode and the next step is about the training signal, not the budget, and the report must say so with the numbers
a single-leg diagnostic result may not be reported as a six-leg or walking result
discipline: every earlier preregistration and amendment is left byte-identical. This is the tenth documented change of the round and the report lists all ten.
